お見事です。レダさん。
私も隣で訓練しても構いませんか？
text.official_en: Impressive, Leda. May I train by your side?

あなた、女王にしては十分な腕前じゃない？

Of course—but I would have thought your skills were
already honed enough for a queen.

No. I'll be striding into battle as well. One can never
train too much for that.

せめて弓の腕ぐらいは並ばせてください。
text.official_en:
Besides, I'm nowhere near you in artistic skill.
At least let me try to match you in archery.
